interface.title: Febre Amarela no Brasil – painel de casos e vacinação (Angular + Highcharts dashboard)
interface.field: Epidemiology / public health surveillance (yellow fever in Brazil)
interface.stage_of_work: Descriptive analysis and exploration of surveillance data that was already collected
interface.what_it_is_for: Explore confirmed yellow fever cases in Brazil (1995–2023) by region, state, time, season, age and sex, and set them against vaccine doses applied, using a filter panel that drives the charts.

data.note: All data loads with the app (geo-cases.json and doses.json). There is no upload or sign-in. Only two of the six charts respond to the filter panel: 'Eficácia das Campanhas de Vacinação' and 'Distribuição de Casos por Região'. The time series, seasonal, age-vs-onset scatter and age/sex charts stay the same under every filter. The age/sex and scatter charts show small round numbers (totals 10–45) that look like placeholder data. On first paint the vaccination chart was empty and the region bars were lower (Sudeste about 1,740). After the data finished loading, Sudeste showed 2,347 (screens/001.webp vs screens/004.webp, screens/024.webp).

features.name: Collapsible multi-facet filter panel driving linked charts
features.general: Pick values for several categorical facets (time, area, sub-area, age band, sex), apply them together, and have the summary charts redraw on the subset. Reset brings back the full data. Caveats: only the time, area and sex facets worked; choosing a sub-area (Estado) or an age band (Idade) empties the charts. Each facet takes one value at a time, and reset leaves the old values showing in the dropdowns.
features.specific: Expand 'Filtro'. Choose Ano / Região / Gênero from single-select Material dropdowns (Estado and Idade are offered but empty the region and vaccination charts; Ano offers only 2020–2023). Press 'Aplicar Filtro' and the vaccination and region charts redraw. 'Resetar Filtro' restores all data but the dropdowns keep their old values; reloading the page clears them. The chevron on the Filtro header collapses the panel.
steps: Expand the Filtro panel
Choose one value in one or more of Ano, Região, Gênero (Estado and Idade empty the charts)
Press Aplicar Filtro and read the redrawn charts
Change a value and apply again to compare subsets
Press Resetar Filtro to go back to all data (dropdowns keep their values), then collapse the panel to give the charts more room
serves_tasks: Drill from a region to its sub-areas
Restrict to one sex and compare with the other
Combine a time filter with a place filter
Clear the filters and return to the full view

features.specific: 'Distribuição de Casos por Região' shows the five regions. With Região = Sudeste it shows MG/ES/SP/RJ, with Norte it shows PA/AC/TO/RR/AM/RO, and a tooltip gives Casos per bar.

features.name: Intervention vs outcome dual-series timeline with adaptive time grain
features.general: Plot an intervention series and an outcome series on one timeline. Toggle a series off to rescale onto the other, and hover for values. Filtering to one year switches the axis from years to months.
features.specific: 'Eficácia das Campanhas de Vacinação' plots Doses de imunobiológicos aplicadas and Casos per year. Clicking a legend item hides that series. With Ano chosen, the x-axis becomes year-month (2020-1…2020-4, 2021-5, 2021-7), but every doses point is then 0.

Filter to a year (and region) to see a monthly breakdown
Click the legend item again to restore

features.name: Stacked age-band × sex bar chart with legend isolation
features.general: Stacked bars of counts per age band split by sex, with stack totals. Clicking legend items isolates one group, and a hover gives the group and total counts.
features.specific: 'Distribuição de Casos por Faixa Etária e Sexo': stacks Masculino and Feminino across 0-10…61+. Clicking Masculino or Feminino in the legend hides that sex and the axis rescales. The tooltip shows 'Masculino: 25, Total: 45'.

features.name: Long-run case time series with hover readout
features.general: A line chart of yearly counts over decades for spotting outbreak years, with exact values on hover.
features.specific: 'Distribuição Temporal dos Casos' 1995–2023 shows the 2017 (about 800) and 2018 (1,306) peaks. The hover tooltip gives 'Casos'.

Hover a peak point to read the year and count
serves_tasks: Find the outbreak years in a long time series

features.name: Seasonal monthly-profile line chart
features.general: A line of average counts per calendar month (January to December), pooled over all years, for spotting the season when cases cluster, with exact values on hover.
features.specific: 'Padrões Sazonais na Incidência da Febre Amarela' plots average Casos for janeiro…dezembro. Janeiro is highest (about 71), values fall through abril and rise again by dezembro (about 13). The tooltip gives 'Casos: 71.1111…'. It does not respond to the filter panel.
steps: Scan the January–December line for the high and low months
Hover a month point to read its average count
serves_tasks: See which months cases cluster in

screens_never_reached: Heat map component: according to the code notes it is imported but never placed in the page, so it never appears
Years before 2020 in the Ano filter: the dropdown offers only 2020, 2021, 2022 and 2023, so the 2017–2018 outbreak years cannot be filtered to (screens/005.webp)
not_done: Filtering by state did not work. Estado = Minas Gerais with Região Sudeste emptied both linked charts (screens/018.webp). Estado = Pará with 2021 + Norte emptied the region chart, even though PA had 3 cases in that subset (screens/044.webp vs screens/045.webp). The likely cause is that the dropdown uses full state names while the data uses abbreviations (MG, PA).

Filtering by age band did not work. Idade = 36-45 (with Masculino) emptied the region chart (screens/022.webp), and 26-35 in the combined filter did the same (screens/013.webp). The filter's bands (0-17, 18-25, 26-35, 36-45, 46-60, 60+) also do not match the chart's bands (0-10, 11-20, …, 61+) (screens/011.webp).

The age/sex chart, time series, seasonal chart and scatter never respond to the filters, so the 'break down by age and sex within a filtered subset' goal could only be done on the fixed national chart.

Comparing doses with cases is only possible across all years. When a single year is chosen, every doses point is 0 (screens/007.webp, screens/044.webp), because the doses data appear to be yearly only. With both series shown, cases sit flat at 0 on the doses scale, so you have to hide doses to see them.

Resetar Filtro restores the charts but leaves the old values in the dropdowns (screens/014.webp, screens/023.webp). After a reset the vaccination chart's x-axis labels were sometimes shifted against the points (screens/014.webp). I cleared the dropdowns by reloading the page.
The dropdowns are single-select. I found no way to pick several years or regions at once.
